test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

This work is __much heavy to do__ by one person single-handedly.
solution:
The correct answer is **'too heavy to be done'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we **read the sentence**, we **get to know the following things.**
 
• The sentence is in **the passive voice.**
 
• In the sentence, we need to use "**too... to", **which means **'more than is necessary or desirable'.**
 
• **For example:**
 
• The sum is very difficult. It cannot be solved by me.
 
 
• *The sum is **too difficult to be solved** by me.*
 
 
 
• The work is very heavy. It cannot be done by one person single-handedly.
 
 
• *The work is **too heavy to be done** by one person single-handedly.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the concept with some more examples.

 
• He was too nervous. He could not perform well on the stage.
 
 
• He was **too nervous to perform **well on the stage.
 
 

 
• I was very busy. I could not talk to her.
 
 
• *I was too busy to talk to her.*
